title: SB39 (2020 Regular): Public Safety - Regulated Firearm - Definition

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2020RS/bills/sb/sb0039f.pdf)
provenance.note: First reader (as filed), mgaleg.maryland.gov; no date in text. Other changes are only renumbering of the existing list (bracketed old numbers, capitalised new numbers).

operative_text: Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-101(r)): “Regulated firearm” means: (1) a handgun; or ... (2) a firearm that is any of the following specific assault weapons or their copies, regardless of which company produced and manufactured that assault weapon: ... (iv) ANDERSON MANUFACTURING .223 CALIBER AM–15 AND .300 CALIBER AM–15;
